objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with symptoms of food poisoning, taking into account the history of presentation and clinical findings.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—I'm a 20-year-old college student, and about two hours ago I started having abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. It began roughly an hour after I ate reheated food from earlier in the day. I don’t have fever, chest pain, cough, rash, or any urinary symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to urinate suddenly, or feeling like you have to go right away when you feel the urge?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I’m not having sudden or urgent urges to urinate, and there’s no pain or burning when I do.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or mass in your breast that you hadn't been aware of before?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any firm lump or any new mass in my breast, and I don’t have any breast-related pain or skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, smooth, and firm bumps on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any small, smooth, firm bumps on my skin. I’ve mainly had the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling like you can't seem to cool down or catch your breath, even when you're in a cool environment or not exerting yourself much?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t been feeling unusually overheated, and I’m not having trouble catching my breath. My main issue has been the abdominal cramps along with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started about two hours ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling overwhelmed, anxious, or struggling to cope with your emotions lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t been feeling overwhelmed, anxious, or struggling to cope. My symptoms have been pretty focused on the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since they started.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any itching sensations on my skin, either all over or in any specific areas.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that it's been harder to find the right words when you're talking lately? Sometimes people have trouble thinking of the word they want to use, and it's a bit frustrating. Have you experienced anything like that?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any trouble finding the right words or thinking of what I want to say. My symptoms have stayed centered on the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since they started about two hours ago.”
